note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Adds Relay-style connection (edge) queries with cursor pagination. Distinctive per-bundle config key: entity_config.<type>.<bundle>.edges_enabled; global settings.edge_max_limit. Medium/hard cases are grounded in entity_config.node.article.edges_enabled on graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_edges add to a GraphQL Compose schema, and what pagination style does it use?
evals.expected_output: It adds Relay-style Connection queries (edges/nodes with cursors and pageInfo) so clients can load many entities of a bundle at once with cursor-based pagination.

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_edges, which config key turns on the connection (edge) query for a specific bundle such as node article?
How do you cap the maximum number of items a single graphql_compose_edges connection query can return?
evals.expected_output: Set settings.edge_max_limit (an integer) in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server; it defaults to EntityConnection::MAX_LIMIT.

evals.prompt: On this site, one node bundle has the GraphQL Compose edge/connection query enabled. Inspect the config and name that node bundle.
Using graphql_compose_edges, enable the cursor-paginated connection (edge) query for the Article node type on the default GraphQL Compose server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
